agree.reason: The concrete details (running the 3 a.m. shift alone, nine early mastitis catches, two missed shifts in three years) set this letter apart from generic praise, so a quick reader with no prior view would likely rank Tomás well, though a careful one might notice some claims that read as padding.

honest.reason: Several claims go beyond the brief: 'taught himself' the software, 'nobody asked him to take this on', 'he picked up the 3 a.m. shift again', the trust-earned backstory, the change from following instructions to making judgments, and 'seriously ill'; the 'without reservation' line also sits awkwardly with leaving out the two days' notice.

works_the_facts.reason: It works out his age (22) and explains why early detection matters, but it never turns 'two missed shifts in three years' into its strongest form, roughly 2 out of about 750 scheduled shifts, or better than 99% attendance.

right_comparison.reason: The only comparison is a passing claim that he brings practical experience many students won't have, which roughly places him against the other applicants without developing the point.
